full.text:
<<ON PRESSING APPLES FOR CIDER THIS SEASON>>  

PRESSING APPLES FOR CIDER IS A NEIGHBORHOOD FOCUS. APPLES ARE BEING PRESSING FOR CIDER IN THE NEIGHBORHOOD. THIS IS A LOCAL EFFORT TO PRESERVE THE FARMING TRADITION AND PROMOTE LOCAL FARMING. THE PROCESS IS SIMPLE BUT FUN. APPLES ARE SELECTED FOR THEIR SIZE AND TASTE. THEY ARE THEN CUT AND PRESSED TO MAKE CIDER. THIS IS A GREAT WAY TO ENJOY THE FRESHNESS OF APPLES AND SUPPORT LOCAL FARMERS. THE CIDER IS THEN READY TO BE DRINKED. THIS IS A GREAT WAY TO CONNECT WITH THE NEIGHBORHOOD AND SUPPORT LOCAL ECONOMY.  

THE CIDER IS A DELICIOUS WAY TO RELATE TO THE LAND AND THE NEIGHBORHOOD. THANK YOU FOR SUPPORTING LOCAL FARMING AND CIDER MAKING.  

[WOOD TYPE] [STREET NAME] [MAP SHEET] [JAR LABEL]
